mapper.select: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM studyroom_event_streams WHERE stream_id=#{streamId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM studyroom_event_streams WHERE stream_id=#{streamId} AND user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM study_outline_drafts WHERE id=#{entityId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT r.id FROM studyroom_runs r JOIN study_rooms s ON s.current_run_id=r.id JOIN study_outline_drafts d ON d.id=r.draft_id WHERE r.id=#{runId} AND r.user_id=#{userId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM study_outline_drafts WHERE id=#{draftId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT r.* FROM studyroom_runs r JOIN study_rooms s ON s.current_run_id=r.id JOIN study_outline_drafts d ON d.id=r.draft_id WHERE r.id=#{runId} AND r.user_id=#{userId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT f.id FROM studyroom_fragments f JOIN studyroom_units u ON u.id=f.unit_id WHERE f.run_id=#{runId} AND f.step_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY u.unit_order,f.fragment_order LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM studyroom_generation_jobs WHERE id=#{jobId} AND user_id=#{userId}
SELECT * FROM studyroom_events WHERE stream_id=#{streamId} AND sequence>#{since} AND sequence<=#{cursor} ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 100
SELECT stream_id,user_id FROM studyroom_event_streams WHERE terminal=TRUE AND terminal_at<#{before}
SELECT * FROM studyroom_event_streams WHERE stream_id=#{streamId} AND terminal=TRUE AND terminal_at<#{before} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE studyroom_event_streams SET floor_sequence=last_sequence WHERE stream_id=#{streamId}
